metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is asking about artificial land built off the coast of Jakarta Bay, specifically if it was greater than 800 hectares as of 2021. This requires: 1. Identifying artificial/built-up land in coastal areas near Jakarta 2. Calculating the area of this artificial land 3. Comparing it to 800 hectares Best approach: - Use Global Man-made Impervious Surface (GMIS) dataset which shows built-up areas - Focus on Jakarta Bay area (around coordinates: 106.8°E, -6.1°S) - Use data from 2021 timeframe - Calculate area of built-up surfaces and convert to hectares I'll use: - GMIS dataset for built-up areas - Define a region around Jakarta Bay - Calculate total built-up area - Compare to 800 hectares threshold Need to handle: - Data availability check - Valid pixel count check - Area calculation validation ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Jakarta Bay region (approximate coordinates) const jakartaBay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [106.5, -6.0], [107.1, -6.0], [107.1, -6.3], [106.5, -6.3], [106.5, -6.0] ]); // Load Global Man-made Impervious Surface (GMIS) dataset for 2021 // GMIS shows built-up/artificial surfaces const gmis = ee.ImageCollection('Oxford/MAP/GMIC_v1') .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filterBounds(jakartaBay); // Check data availability const collectionSize = gmis.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 GMIS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the built-up layer (impervious surface percentage) const builtUp = gmis.first().select('b1'); // Threshold to identify artificial land (typically >30% impervious) const artificialLand = builtUp.gt(30); // Calculate area in square meters, then convert to hectares const areaStats = artificialLand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().unweighted(), geometry: jakartaBay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelArea = areaStats.get('b1').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (pixelArea === null || pixelArea === undefined) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate area in hectares (1000m scale means 1 pixel = 1 hectare) const areaHectares = pixelArea; console.log(`Artificial land area: ${areaHectares.toFixed(2)} hectares`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelArea.toFixed(0)}`); // Validate result if (areaHectares === null || areaHectares === undefined || areaHectares < 0 || areaHectares > 100000) { // Sanity check console.log("C3"); } else if (areaHectares > 800) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
